decisions.statement: Every attribute is counted from 2026-09-06 and from no day earlier.
A counted day is a tracked day falling on or after the day the counting begins.
A total is the sum of an attribute's points over the counted days.
A day before the day the counting begins is left out of every total.
A total may be asked for the days short of a day the caller names.
The day named is itself left out.
A total naming no day counts every counted day.
A date is compared as text rather than as a date.
A day's points are worked out by the code beside that attribute's page.
The days are read in one ask.
The days are summed oldest first.
A day with nothing an attribute counts adds nothing to that attribute.
An attribute no day has a figure for is an absent total.
The plants are counted over the span the counted days cover.
The rejections are counted over that same span.
The span opens where the first counted day opens.
The span closes where the last counted day closes.
A span reaching no counted day at all leaves the entries unread rather than zero.
The days that cannot be read leave every attribute unread rather than zero.
No total is kept beside a readout.
Nothing here turns a total into a color.
Nothing here writes.

definition: the points each attribute has earned since the day the counting begins
